web-mobile.archive.title: Archived
web-mobile.chat.jobsNoneNote: Web pages and long-running watch jobs an agent starts appear here.
web-mobile.chat.offline: Can't reach the station. Messages are delivered once it's back.
web-mobile.connects.appGone: This app is no longer on this station; it may have connected or been removed
web-mobile.connects.avatarNote: Pick one below, or upload an image.
web-mobile.connects.config.step1: Open {link} and sign in to the Slack workspace the bot will live in.
web-mobile.connects.config.step2: Scroll to "Your App Configuration Tokens" at the bottom, tap Generate Token and pick this workspace.
web-mobile.connects.config.step3: Paste the Refresh Token (starts with xoxe-1-) below. {name} renews it automatically from then on.
web-mobile.connects.configNote: With a Slack config token, {name} creates the Slack app for you: set its name, avatar and permissions here instead of in Slack's admin pages. It's yours alone.
web-mobile.connects.deleteText: The Slack connection will close. You need to delete the app in Slack yourself.

web-mobile.connects.deleteTextSessions.one: The Slack connection will close; its 1 session keeps its history but gets no new messages. You need to delete the app in Slack yourself.
web-mobile.connects.deleteTextSessions.other: The Slack connection will close; its {n} sessions keep their history but get no new messages. You need to delete the app in Slack yourself.

web-mobile.connects.dropText: Removes it from {name} only. The app stays in Slack; if you no longer need it, delete it in Slack's app settings.
web-mobile.connects.everyMessage: Every message it sees goes to the session.
web-mobile.connects.install.manual: The app is ready. {link}, then copy the Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-…) from the {oauth}.
web-mobile.connects.install.oauth: The app is ready. {link}: tap "Allow" in Slack and the bot token goes to the station automatically.
web-mobile.connects.install.socket: Generate an App-Level Token on the {link} page and copy it (xapp-…; scopes preselected).
web-mobile.connects.manual.create: Create a Slack app with {name}'s config
web-mobile.connects.manual.install: On the Install App page, install to the workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token.
web-mobile.connects.manual.socket: On the app's Socket Mode page, generate an App-Level Token (scopes preselected)
web-mobile.connects.manualLong: Create the app in Slack manually, without a config token
web-mobile.connects.manualShort: Create it manually, without a config token
web-mobile.connects.mentionOff: Every channel message it sees goes to the session.
web-mobile.connects.mentionOn: Once @mentioned in a thread, later replies don't need an @mention.
web-mobile.connects.noModels: {runtime} profiles have no models enabled. Enable some on the station page first.
web-mobile.connects.noModelsHere: This station's profiles have no models enabled. Enable some on its station page first.
web-mobile.connects.noSession: No session yet; the next message starts one
web-mobile.connects.noSessions: No sessions yet. @{name} in Slack to start one.
web-mobile.connects.note: A connect is how people reach {name}, such as a Slack app. Each connect lives on one station and is bound to one model.
web-mobile.connects.offlineWait: Station offline; continue once it's back
web-mobile.connects.pickSessionNote: Messages to "{name}" now go to the chosen session. The old one is kept but gets no new messages from this connect.
web-mobile.connects.pickTeam: Choose the Slack workspace whose config token creates the app
web-mobile.connects.profileFirstNote: Connects run models through a profile. Add one, then come back.
web-mobile.connects.runNote: New sessions use the new settings; ongoing ones keep theirs.
web-mobile.connects.runtimeNote: Runs on {runtime}, fixed once created; for another runtime, create a new connect. Ongoing sessions keep their settings.
web-mobile.connects.savedToken: Saved {token}; leave blank to keep it
web-mobile.connects.scopesNote: Default permissions (all on); you can change them on a computer later.
web-mobile.connects.tokensNote: You can change just one; leave the other blank to keep the saved one.
web-mobile.connects.feishu.name: Feishu
web-mobile.connects.feishu.slackNote: Use it in Slack channels and DMs
web-mobile.connects.feishu.feishuNote: Use it in Feishu groups and chats, Lark included
web-mobile.connects.feishu.scanNote: Scan with Feishu to create and set up the bot
web-mobile.connects.feishu.appNote: Enter the App ID and App Secret from the developer console
web-mobile.connects.feishu.qr: QR code to create the Feishu bot
web-mobile.connects.feishu.scanHint: You can also scan it with Feishu on another device
web-mobile.connects.feishu.appHint: The app needs the bot capability and long connection on, the message event and card callback subscribed, the permissions granted and a version published.
web-mobile.connects.feishu.larkNote: Turn on for an app made on larksuite.com
web-mobile.connects.feishu.replaceNote: The new App Secret is verified before it is saved. The connect then reconnects.
web-mobile.connects.mentionOn.feishu: Once mentioned, later messages in the same group need no @.
web-mobile.connects.mentionOff.feishu: Every message in the groups it is in goes to the session.
web-mobile.connects.noSessions.feishu: No sessions yet. @-mention {name} in a Feishu group or message it directly to start
web-mobile.connects.deleteText.feishu: Disconnects from Feishu. You need to delete the app in the developer console yourself.

web-mobile.connects.deleteTextSessions.f.one: Disconnects from Feishu. Its 1 session keeps its history but gets no new messages. You need to delete the app in the developer console yourself.
web-mobile.connects.deleteTextSessions.f.other: Disconnects from Feishu. Its {n} sessions keep their history but get no new messages. You need to delete the app in the developer console yourself.

web-mobile.history.accountNote: In auto mode, the account switches when quota runs out or sign-in expires; a chosen account is always used.
web-mobile.history.effortNote: Higher effort is slower and uses more quota.
web-mobile.history.fastNote: Fast is quicker but uses more quota or credits.
web-mobile.home.emptyMany: No chats yet. @ them in Slack, or
web-mobile.home.emptyOne: No chats yet. @ it in Slack, or
web-mobile.home.renameHint: Leave blank to use the first message
web-mobile.me.title: Account
web-mobile.memory.note: Memory shared by every chat on a station, kept by the agent. Not synced between stations.
web-mobile.memory.sub: Shared by all chats, kept by the agent
web-mobile.newChat.askNote: Describe the task. It starts a new chat on {station} with the chosen model.
web-mobile.newChat.enableModel: Enable a model in a profile first
web-mobile.newChat.fastNote: Faster, uses more quota or credits
web-mobile.newChat.noProfile: Add a profile to {station}. Agents run models with it: a subscription (Claude, ChatGPT) or a provider key.
web-mobile.newChat.noneOnlineNote: Open {name} on a machine to connect it to this workspace.
web-mobile.newChat.title: New chat
web-mobile.noStation: This station isn't in this workspace
web-mobile.notes.label: Note {n}
web-mobile.openJobs.label: Long-running services and jobs
web-mobile.stations.agentEnvNote: Agents, logins and tasks started by this station load these variables, commonly to set an HTTP proxy. One NAME=value per line; you can paste a .env file. Leave a masked value as it is to keep it. A Profile's variable of the same name takes precedence. After saving, idle agent processes restart; running ones pick up the change after their current turn.
web-mobile.profiles.addedMachine: Profile added with this machine's sign-in
web-mobile.profiles.backgroundOff: New messages wait until running commands or subagents finish.
web-mobile.profiles.backgroundOn: Running commands and subagents move to the background; the agent reads the message at once.
web-mobile.profiles.codexNote: On the OpenAI page, sign in with the ChatGPT account {name} should use and paste the code. This page continues automatically. If device code sign-in is off, turn it on in ChatGPT's security settings first.
web-mobile.profiles.opencodeNote: On the OpenCode page that opens, sign in, check that its code matches this one, then choose the workspace with Go and authorize. This page continues by itself once you are done.
web-mobile.profiles.kimiNote: On the Kimi page that opens, sign in with the account that has Kimi Code, check that the code matches, then authorize. This page continues by itself once you are done.
web-mobile.profiles.grokNote: On the xAI page that opens, sign in with the account that has SuperGrok or X Premium+, enter the code, then approve. This page continues by itself once you are done.
web-mobile.profiles.cursorNote: On the Cursor page that opens, sign in and confirm. This page continues by itself once you are done.
web-mobile.profiles.copyCodeFailed: Couldn't copy; enter the code above manually
web-mobile.profiles.deleteText: Removes it from {name}'s config only; the config folder and its sign-in are kept. Sessions running on it move to another Profile, or stop if none is available.
web-mobile.profiles.disableText: {name} stops using this machine's sign-in. The sign-in itself stays and can be used again later. Sessions running on it move to another Profile, or stop if none is available.
web-mobile.profiles.envNote: The runtime starts with these variables to reach your model service. {route} in a value is replaced with the session's route ID.
web-mobile.profiles.fastNote: Applies to sessions on plan default; Fast uses more quota or credits
web-mobile.profiles.loginWhere: Sign-in happens on the machine running {name}; you just authorize in the browser.
web-mobile.profiles.loginWhereAdd: Sign-in happens on the machine running {name}; you just authorize in the browser. The profile is added once it succeeds.
web-mobile.profiles.machineNote: "Use this account" uses this machine's own sign-in, so switching accounts or signing out there changes it too. Sign-ins the station can't read (Codex's in the keychain, or a locked keychain) can't be used; sign in once separately for {name}. The original sign-in is unaffected.
web-mobile.profiles.modelsEmpty: Once the profile is checked, its models are listed here. Tick the ones to use.
web-mobile.profiles.modelsNote: Only ticked models can be chosen for new chats and connects.
web-mobile.profiles.note: Accounts agents use to run models. Ones needing attention come first; tap for the cause and how to fix it.
web-mobile.settings.appearance.title: Appearance
web-mobile.settings.notify.denied: Blocked by the browser. Allow notifications in site settings
web-mobile.settings.notify.title: Notifications
web-mobile.settings.title: Settings
web-mobile.sheets.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; long-press the command to copy it
web-mobile.signIn.many: Sign in to several accounts; switch workspaces any time.
web-mobile.signIn.text: Sign in to see all stations and chats in your workspaces.
web-mobile.signIn.title: Keep your agents working
web-mobile.stations.addNote: A station is a machine running {name}. Name it, then run the generated command in its terminal; it installs {name} and joins.
web-mobile.stations.firstNote: Agents work on your machines. Start by adding a Mac or Linux machine.
web-mobile.stations.joined: "{name}" joined. You can open it now.
web-mobile.stations.longGone: Hasn't connected to {name} in a while
web-mobile.stations.offlineNote: Offline: open {name} on it to reconnect
web-mobile.stations.removeText: It disconnects from {name} cloud and members can no longer reach it here. {name} and the data on the machine stay; you can add it again later.
web-mobile.stations.runNote: macOS (Apple silicon), Linux or WSL on Windows, even with {name} already installed. It installs {name}, joins this workspace and runs in the background. Once joined, add a profile on its station page.
web-mobile.stations.waitAdmin: No stations yet. Ask an admin to add one.
web-mobile.stations.waiting: Waiting for the machine to join · Continues once the command runs · Command valid for 1 hour
web-mobile.usage.note: Tokens the agents used on models, priced at API rates
web-mobile.usage.pricesNote: Unit prices stations use to estimate cost
web-mobile.versions.betaNote: New versions land here first; may be unstable
web-mobile.versions.title: Versions
web-mobile.workspace.addNote: Added to "{workspace}" directly, no acceptance needed. People who've used {name} join now; others join on first sign-in with this email.

web-mobile.workspace.deleteText.one: All members lose access, and 1 station disconnects from {name} cloud (its local data stays).
web-mobile.workspace.deleteText.other: All members lose access, and {n} stations disconnect from {name} cloud (their local data stays).

web-mobile.workspace.leaveText: You'll lose access to its stations; rejoining needs a new invite.
web-mobile.workspace.relayHint: An iroh-relay https address. The web app requires a publicly issued certificate (such as Let's Encrypt); self-signed certificates aren't supported.
web-mobile.workspace.relayLead: Besides {name}'s relays, stations and members' devices also connect through these relays, using the fastest.
web-mobile.workspace.removeMemberText: They lose access to this workspace's stations. You can re-invite them later.
web-mobile.workspaces.addAccountNote: Add another account; others stay signed in
web-mobile.workspaces.codeNote: The free plan includes 1 workspace and this account has used it. Enter an invite code to upgrade to Standard and create more.
web-mobile.workspaces.name: Name
web-mobile.workspaces.newNote: A workspace is a group of people and their shared stations. You'll be its owner.
web-mobile.workspaces.title: Switch workspace
web-mobile.bar.title: Bottom bar
web-mobile.bar.note: Set up several bars of up to 4 places each; the current one shows at the bottom. With more than one, swipe up on the bar to switch. Hold an icon and drag it sideways to reorder.
web-mobile.bar.oneLeft: With only one bar left, swiping up on the bar does nothing
web-mobile.bar.onlyOne: There's only one bar, so swiping up on it does nothing.
web-mobile.borrow.title: Borrow account
web-mobile.borrow.done: Borrowed; usable here once it reaches this station
web-mobile.profiles.step1Short: On the page, sign in with the Claude account {name} should use and agree
web-mobile.profiles.step1ShortDevin: On the page, sign in with the Devin account {name} should use
web-mobile.profiles.step2Short: Paste the code the page shows here
web-mobile.profiles.pickModels.title: Select models
web-mobile.profiles.pickModels.lead: {name} was added. Only enabled models can be selected for new chats and connects; you can change them later on the profile's page.
web-mobile.profiles.pickModels.none: This profile lists no models; you can add them later on its page
web-mobile.agent.compacting: Compacting context; the chat says when it's done
web-mobile.agent.compactSub: Keeps a summary and frees up context
web-mobile.agent.clearSub: Ends the process; the next message starts a new session
